knowledge:
- key_parameters: sce=A SingleCellExperiment object to be converted to GDS format ;; cnt=A dense or sparse matrix of count data to be converted to GDS format ;; fn=Path to the GDS file to be loaded as a SingleCellExperiment object ;; logcnt=A DelayedMatrix of log-transformed counts used for summarization
- alternatives: HDF5 & TileDB=Alternative file-based representations; GDS is preferred because it supports direct storage of sparse matrices without converting them to multiple vectors ;; scater::runPCA()=Standard PCA method; scRunPCA() is preferred for large-scale datasets because it performs SVD on the covariance matrix to reduce memory usage, avoiding beachmat's memory-intensive file-backed matrix realization
- when_to_use: When analyzing large-scale single-cell omics datasets (e.g., hundreds of thousands or millions of cells) where in-memory processing would cause out-of-memory errors
- pitfalls: Using standard scater::runPCA() on large GDS-backed datasets can trigger high memory usage due to in-memory realization; use scRunPCA() instead ;; Forgetting to close an opened GDS file using scClose() after calling scOpen() ;; Converting matrices without row or column names will trigger warnings and auto-generate placeholder names

workflows.name: gds_single_cell_analysis
workflows.intent: Convert single-cell data to GDS format, load it as a GDS-backed SingleCellExperiment, and perform memory-efficient downstream analysis.
input: example.rds (SingleCellExperiment object containing single-cell expression data)
example.gds (Genomic Data Structure file containing single-cell expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert SingleCellExperiment or matrix to GDS format using scConvGDS() ;; 2. Load GDS file as a SingleCellExperiment using scExperiment() ;; 3. Normalize counts using logNormCounts() ;; 4. Calculate row and column summarizations using colMeans(), rowMeans(), and scRowMeanVar() ;; 5. Perform memory-efficient PCA using scRunPCA() ;; 6. Perform UMAP dimensionality reduction using runUMAP()
workflows.code:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SCArray))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SingleCellExperiment))
fn <- system.file("extdata", "example.rds", package="SCArray")
sce <- readRDS(fn)
scConvGDS(sce, "test.gds")
(f <- scOpen("test.gds"))
scClose(f)
library(Matrix)
cnt <- matrix(0, nrow=4, ncol=8)
set.seed(100); cnt[sample.int(length(cnt), 8)] <- rpois(8, 4)
(cnt <- as(cnt, "sparseMatrix"))
scConvGDS(cnt, "test.gds")
(fn <- system.file("extdata", "example.gds", package="SCArray"))
sce <- scExperiment(fn)
cnt <- assays(sce)$counts
logcnt <- log2(cnt + 1)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scuttle))
sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
col_mean <- colMeans(logcnt)
row_mean <- rowMeans(logcnt)
mvar <- scRowMeanVar(logcnt)
sce <- scRunPCA(sce)
plotReducedDim(sce, dimred="PCA")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scater))
sce <- runUMAP(sce)
plotReducedDim(sce, dimred="UMAP")
